lines.en: Would you like to respond to this message?
What would you like to say?
: I don't think you're legally allowed to send me nudes of other people without their consent.
lines.zh: : 我觉得在法律上，你未经本人同意就给我发别人的裸照是不太行的。

lines.en: : Should I refrain from doing this in the future?
lines.zh: : 那我以后是不是应该收敛点？

lines.en: : No. I'm looking forward to the continuation of this series.
lines.zh: : 不。我很期待这个系列的续集。

lines.en: : Yesssss. More pictures of the wild Fukuyama in all of its buxom glory.
lines.zh: : 好好好好。多来点野生 Fukuyama 波涛汹涌的倩影。

lines.en: : Are you jerking off right now?
: Nope. Just admiring the view.
: Lame.
: Maybe if you got a little closer when you took the picture.
lines.zh: : 你拍照的时候要是再凑近点就好了。

lines.en: : I will remember that in the future ;D
: There is one glaring problem with this image.
lines.zh: : 这张照片有一个非常明显的问题。

lines.en: : Oh? Do tell.
: Why do you have a towel on?
lines.zh: : 你为什么围着一条毛巾？

lines.en: : Because I had already finished my shower, Sensei.
: It wouldn't be appropriate for me to just traipse around in the nude.
lines.zh: : 就这么一丝不挂地到处晃悠，不太合适吧。

lines.en: : But it was appropriate to take a nude picture of Futaba without her consent?
lines.zh: : 那未经 Futaba 同意就给她拍裸照就合适了？

lines.en: : Oh, wow. I didn't even realize she was in the picture.
lines.zh: : 哦哇。我都没注意到她在画面里。

lines.en: : I was just trying to take a cute selfie.
lines.zh: : 我只是想拍张可爱的自拍。

lines.en: : You'd be cuter without clothes on.
: Oh yeah? ;D
: I'll keep that in mind for my next selfie.
lines.zh: : 我拍下一张自拍的时候会记住的。

lines.en: : Excellent research photo, Nodoka.
: I camped out nine hours for this shot.
lines.zh: : 为了这一张，我蹲点了九个小时。

lines.en: : You camped out in the shower for nine hours?
lines.zh: : 你在浴室里蹲点了九个小时？

lines.en: : I really like showers.
: I also really like breasts.
: I regret nothing.
: Do you have any more?
: Not at the moment. But I'm currently waiting outside of her normal camping grounds for the chance to take another.
lines.zh: : 暂时没有。不过我正守在她常出没的营地外头，等着机会再拍一张。

lines.en: : I shall keep you in the loop.
: Oh shit! Gotta go!
: The Fukuyama approaches!
